## UX Design Conference speaker bio

Alice is a technology and product leader involved in cross-functional product strategy, user research, and software delivery. Her documented work includes shaping product roadmaps, coordinating user interviews, synthesizing findings from 12 interviews, contributing to mobile onboarding and accessibility reviews, and supporting customer-focused product decisions. She has also presented product progress and demos to executive stakeholders, receiving positive feedback on the user experience.

Alongside her product and UX-adjacent work, Alice contributes to technical architecture, engineering planning, and team leadership. She has participated in architecture reviews, supported engineering process improvements, mentored colleagues, and taken on an interim tech-lead role. Her perspective connects user needs with practical product strategy and scalable technical implementation.

*Editorial note: The available records do not verify Alice’s formal job title, employer, degrees or certifications, prior speaking engagements, portfolio, or public contact information. Those details should be added only after confirmation from Alice or an authoritative professional-profile source.*
